en: A colorized historical street scene showing a broad cobblestone avenue with tram tracks, several trams, horse-drawn carriages, and pedestrians. Multi‑story brick and plaster buildings with shops line both sides of the street, and a church or town-hall style tower with a clock rises in the background on the right. Printed greetings and captions appear in German, Russian, and another script at the top of the card.
